UPES Bidholi — boundary review

114 geo-tagged field photographs against the proposed OpenStreetMap outline. Nothing on this map is active; the production geofence stays fail-closed until the owner confirms an outline.

Revised boundary: none proposed.

The only reading outside the outline (#98) is rejected as a position. The evidence gives no coordinates for any area the outline leaves out, so a new polygon would have to be drawn from guesses.

Open item: the Boys Hostel. Its gatehouse is 40–60 m beyond reading #89, which is 27 m inside the north-east edge. It is not positioned by any photo.
